dtcg.$description: Web UI Quality extracted project token map. Review before production use.

recommendations: 优先将现有变量映射为背景、表面、文字、边界、操作和状态语义 Token
保留项目已有品牌语言，只有对比、状态或一致性不足时才替换具体数值
设计 Token 与组件结构解耦，避免通过高特异性 CSS 覆盖第三方组件
导出的 DTCG Token 需要设计与前端共同复核后再成为生产单一事实源

representative.text: 首页用于 UI Asset Inventory 真实浏览器验收。示例输入框保存

limitations: Only rendered routes/states reachable in the supplied session are proven.
Authenticated inventory visits only the start route and explicitly approved routes; newly discovered links are recorded but not opened.
Hover/focus pseudo-class styles are not asserted unless visible in the measured state.
Different values are review candidates, not automatic errors; no source changes are performed.

networkPolicy.claimBoundary: Browser routing is enforced in-process; OS/process network isolation is not implied.
